To draw the projections of the points on the same ground line ($XY$) with projectors $15\text{ mm}$ apart:

* **(a) Point A:** In the H.P. ($0\text{ mm}$ above/below $XY$) and $40\text{ mm}$ behind V.P.
  * Front view ($a'$): Lies on the $XY$ line.
  * Top view ($a$): $40\text{ mm}$ **above** the $XY$ line.

* **(b) Point B:** $45\text{ mm}$ below the H.P. and $35\text{ mm}$ behind V.P.
  * Front view ($b'$): $45\text{ mm}$ **below** the $XY$ line.
  * Top view ($b$): $35\text{ mm}$ **above** the $XY$ line.

* **(c) Point C:** $25\text{ mm}$ above the H.P. and $30\text{ mm}$ in front of V.P.
  * Front view ($c'$): $25\text{ mm}$ **above** the $XY$ line.
  * Top view ($c$): $30\text{ mm}$ **below** the $XY$ line.

* **(d) Point D:** $50\text{ mm}$ below the H.P. and $35\text{ mm}$ in front of V.P.
  * Front view ($d'$): $50\text{ mm}$ **below** the $XY$ line.
  * Top view ($d$): $35\text{ mm}$ **below** the $XY$ line.

### Layout Representation:
```text
  a(40 above)      b(35 above)          c(30 below)      d(35 below)
  ----|-----------------|----------------|----------------|---- XY
      |a'               |                |c'              |
     (on XY)            |b'(45 below)    |                |d'(50 below)
```
proTip: Always remember: Front views are measured with respect to H.P. (above/below XY) and Top views are measured with respect to V.P. (above/below XY for behind/in front respectively).
